quickChat.label: Quick chat in races
quickChat.helpText: Preset lines runners can shout during a race (no free text).

roadLife.label: People, traffic and animals on the road
roadLife.helpText: Turn off for a calmer course with cones and puddles only.

pinPosts.label: Pin each day's stage
pinPosts.helpText: Pins the new stage post at the top of the subreddit every day.

dailyRecap.label: Daily race recap
dailyRecap.helpText: The app comments a recap (podium, crashes, most shouted line) under each closed stage.

appPosts.label: How-to-play and celebration posts
appPosts.helpText: The app posts a pinned how-to-play guide on install and a post when the crew finishes a city.

runnerFlair.label: Runner user flair
runnerFlair.helpText: Sets each player's user flair to their bib, stages run, passport stamps and latest finished city. Turn off if your subreddit manages flair itself.

items.label: Post today's marathon stage
items.description: Creates (or re-opens) today's Running Man post
